page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.8xlarge is a general purpose virtual machine instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T95 processor running at a base clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance allocates 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The hardware configuration does not feature dedicated GPUs or included local storage, meaning that all persistent disk storage must be provisioned via remote network-attached block volumes. Networking throughput is defined by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and the server includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

With its 1:4 balance between processing capacity and system memory, the ecs.g9ae.8xlarge offers a balanced resource profile suitable for horizontal scaling without over-allocating either compute or memory resources. It is suited for workloads such as medium-to-large relational databases, distributed caching layers, application backend servers, enterprise web hosting, and standard continuous integration and deployment pipelines.

It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of RAM, offering a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no onboard GPUs and possesses no integrated local NVMe storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence. Network connectivity features a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Because of its balanced resource allocation and dedicated core structure, the ecs.g9ae.8xlarge delivers predictable hardware density for enterprise application tiers, mid-sized databases, containerized services, and CI/CD environments.
